offering_description.value: The company serves diners steaks, sushi, cocktails and other food and drinks at its restaurants, with chefs cooking tableside at its teppanyaki locations. It also offers restaurant licensing, management and franchising opportunities.

quotes.quote: At Benihana, we celebrate what each guest brings to the table. Whether it’s your family, friends, appetites, or enthusiasm, we’re here to transform every meal into a memorable experience. Our skilled teppanyaki chefs prepare your meal right before your eyes. Our USDA Choice steaks are aged to perfection, and our sauces, salad dressings, and crisp vegetables are all made from scratch. Our sushi chefs expertly craft a diverse selection of signature sushi and sashimi using hand-selected, high-quality ingredients. And if you’re thirsty, explore our variety of handcrafted cocktails, wine, beer, and of course, sake. Beyond food, we’re passionate about entertaining you.

Our sushi chefs artfully prepare a wide variety of signature sushi and sashimi, using only hand-selected, high-quality ingredients. If you’re looking for something to quench your thirst, we feature a diverse array of handcrafted cocktails, wine, beer, and sake. Whether you’re celebrating a birthday, a promotion, or simply enjoying a meal, Samurai is the perfect restaurant for any occasion.
